rules: Every migrated Product icon uses DS v2 / Icon for size and tone.
Product glyphs must come from the approved VET45 Icon Library (frame 511:700).
The raw Lucide Icons section is a vendor source pool, not direct Product UI authority.
If a needed glyph is absent from the approved Icon Library, add/approve it in Figma DS first; do not bypass governance by copying the raw Lucide instance.
Disabled is Opacity/Disabled = 0.4 on the parent/component, never a custom icon tone.
No hand-authored SVG/path, no emoji, no approximate icon, and no substitution by glyph name alone.

approvedProductLibrary.rule: Only icons present in the approved VET45 Icon Library are Product-ready. Raw Lucide Icons are vendor source candidates and require promotion/approval before Product use.
